analysis.overall: You spent 88% of the day in range with a steady 126 mg/dL average. Late-evening eating brought a couple of peaks overnight, but your morning rebounded nicely into a smooth flatline.

events.title: Post-lunch dip
events.description: After a 65g lunch bolus, glucose drifted down to a daily low of 63 mg/dL before gently coming back up into range.

events.title: Late evening spike
events.description: Glucose rose rapidly to a high of 214 mg/dL around dinner time, needing several small corrections along with your meal bolus.

events.title: Midnight rebound
events.description: Delayed digestion from late carbs drove glucose back up to 203 mg/dL overnight before additional corrections brought it down.

events.title: Steady morning baseline
events.description: Once the overnight corrections settled, levels stayed remarkably flat between 80 and 110 mg/dL through wake-up time.

events.title: Breakfast handling
events.description: A 40g carb breakfast pre-bolus was timed well, keeping your peak below 140 mg/dL with a smooth descent.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on late-evening meals, as delayed carb absorption caused a second rise around midnight.
